annotationRationale: The cyclic arrangement of the digits permits efficient calculation by regrouping terms according to place value and factoring out their common digit sum.

classificationReview.areaCheck: Prealgebra is appropriate. No area repair is needed.

review.questionCheck: Each place contributes 10 times its place value, giving 10(1000+100+10+1)=11,110. Choice E and the key agree. The supplied shared-question record also matches, and there is no figure contradiction.
review.alternativeMethodCheck: One method is sufficient for this elementary calculation. Direct addition or explicit carrying would add little beyond the retained regrouping argument.
review.annotationCheck: cnm_p117 precisely captures the use of regrouping and distributivity for efficient calculation. Its assessed role is appropriate.
review.areaCheck: Prealgebra is appropriate. No area repair is needed.

methodReviews.mathCheck: Every decimal column contains 1, 2, 3 and 4 once. Summing weighted column contributions gives 10·1111=11,110; this remains valid despite carrying.
methodReviews.sourceMethodCheck: LIVE and AoPS Solutions 1 and 2 support the stated regrouping route. Source-informed-original correctly identifies the third-party basis; the shared equation is mathematically inherent, and no copied explanatory prose is apparent.
methodReviews.pedagogyCheck: The column observation directly motivates the displayed calculation. No omitted transition is material for an AMC 10 learner.
methodReviews.directNodeCheck: cnm_p117 directly matches regrouping by place value and factoring out the common digit sum.
